import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

def git(*arguments):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *arguments], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True).stdout

commits = git("rev-list", "--reverse", "HEAD~3..HEAD").splitlines()

subprocess.run(["git", "add", "--", receipt.as_posix()], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--", receipt.as_posix()], check=True)

& $academy --repository (Get-Location).Path reset P05-checkpoint-remediation

academy="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/arbiter-academy/preview-0.23/bin/arbiter-academy"
"$academy" --repository "$PWD" reset P05-checkpoint-remediation

academy="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/arbiter-academy/preview-0.23/bin/arbiter-academy"
"$academy" --repository "$PWD" reset P05-checkpoint-remediation

actions.expected_result: Academy preserves the earlier attempt and prints the next academy/P05-checkpoint-remediation/ATTEMPT_NUMBER branch.
actions.recovery: If Reset stops, preserve its message and resolve only the named repository condition. Never force-reset or delete a prior attempt.
actions.evidence: A new attempt begins from the clean fixture while the previous history remains inspectable.
